properties.description: Tier-0 PCI-DSS payment authorization, capture, and refund engine using tokenized card vault references (tok_pci_v2) with synchronous 45ms fraud scoring and atomic double-entry ledger posting.
Tier-0 omnichannel checkout orchestrator coordinating inventory reservations, real-time fraud pre-checks, payment charges, and cart-to-order saga compensations.
Tier-0 recurring subscription billing, enterprise invoicing, and payment reconciliation service currently migrating residual legacy v1 charge traffic to v2.
Tier-1 order state machine managing order creation, fulfillment tracking, inventory holds, and asynchronous customer notification events.
Tier-1 B2B partner API gateway enforcing per-tenant rate limits, scoped OIDC token verification, partner checkout delegation, and settlement queries.
Tier-2 omnichannel customer email, SMS, and push notification engine consuming order lifecycle events and reporting delivery receipts back to orders.
Tier-2 merchant webhook delivery dispatcher guaranteeing at-least-once delivery with HMAC-SHA256 payload signatures and dead-letter queue replay.
Tier-2 revenue attribution, conversion funnel, and financial BI pipeline consuming pseudonymized asynchronous DATA_FEED streams isolated from OLTP traffic.
Tier-0 zero-trust identity provider issuing short-lived scoped OIDC tokens, publishing JWKS keys, and enforcing mTLS workload identities across all commerce services.
Tier-0 real-time machine-learning fraud scoring and deterministic rule evaluation engine enforcing a 45ms p99 budget and fail-closed gating for transactions above $500.
Tier-0 SOX-regulated immutable double-entry financial ledger recording balanced write-ahead postings in regional Bangkok Cloud Spanner with Singapore DR backup copies.
Tier-1 real-time SKU catalog and soft-lock stock reservation service managing 15-minute checkout reservation TTLs to prevent overselling.
Tokenized card charge endpoint requiring tok_pci_v2 tokens, Idempotency-Key header, 45ms fail-closed fraud scoring for amounts over $500, and synchronous double-entry ledger commit.
DEPRECATED legacy direct PAN payment charge endpoint scheduled for sunset under REQ-004; remaining AT_RISK consumer is svc-billing.
Idempotent full and partial payment refund endpoint reversing tokenized authorizations and posting compensating double-entry ledger journals.
Primary checkout submission endpoint orchestrating inventory lock verification, fraud pre-scoring, v2 payment charge, and saga rollback on downstream failure.
Real-time cart pricing, tax calculation, promotion validation, and shipping quote endpoint for web, mobile, and partner checkouts.
Internal subscription invoice generation and recurring payment trigger endpoint enforcing SOX audit trails and idempotent posting.
Automated invoice-to-ledger reconciliation endpoint verifying settlement parity against double-entry ledger balances.
Order creation endpoint committing validated checkout payloads, linking inventory soft-locks, and emitting asynchronous order confirmation events.
Low-latency order status and fulfillment timeline lookup endpoint serving customers, notifications, webhooks, and analytics feeds.
External B2B partner checkout ingress enforcing per-tenant rate limits, OIDC scope verification, and checkout delegation.
B2B partner settlement statement and payout status API backed by billing reconciliation records.
Asynchronous notification dispatch endpoint ingesting standard event envelopes for transactional email, SMS, and push alerts.
Delivery receipt and bounce feedback endpoint emitting delivery status events back to the order lifecycle state machine.
Internal merchant webhook enqueue endpoint signing outbound JSON payloads with HMAC-SHA256 and dead-letter queue retry policies.
Public webhook signature verification and replay-window validation helper endpoint for merchant integrations.
Pseudonymized event ingestion endpoint collecting non-blocking BI funnel and revenue telemetry over isolated DATA_FEED streams.
High-fanin zero-trust token exchange endpoint minting 5-minute scoped OIDC JWTs over mTLS for all Tier-0, Tier-1, and Tier-2 microservices.
Public JSON Web Key Set endpoint publishing active and rotating RSA/ECDSA signing keys for stateless OIDC JWT validation.
Real-time ML fraud risk scoring endpoint operating under a strict 45ms p99 SLA with fail-closed enforcement on charges exceeding $500.
Deterministic velocity, BIN blocklist, and sanction rule evaluation API complementing real-time ML fraud scoring.
SOX-compliant immutable double-entry ledger write-ahead posting endpoint enforcing balanced debits, credits, and Idempotency-Key uniqueness.
Strongly consistent merchant and settlement account balance read endpoint backed by Bangkok regional Cloud Spanner.
Transactional SKU soft-lock reservation endpoint creating 15-minute TTL holds during active checkout sessions.
High-throughput SKU metadata, pricing tier, and warehouse availability read endpoint.

properties.title: Legacy Direct PAN Payment Processing (v1)
properties.summary: Legacy v1 architecture allowing raw PAN card payloads directly on POST /v1/payments/charge; superseded by ADR-004 tokenized vault architecture.

properties.title: Nightly Batch Ledger Settlement
properties.summary: Legacy nightly batch settlement job reconciling payments into finance tables; superseded by ADR-008 synchronous write-ahead double-entry ledger posting.

properties.title: 30-Day Informal API Deprecation Notice
properties.summary: Informal 30-day Slack notice before breaking API contract changes; superseded by ADR-010 mandatory 180-day Tier-0 breaking-change freeze.

properties.title: Tokenized Card Vault (tok_pci_v2) & 45ms Fail-Closed Fraud Gate
properties.summary: Mandates PCI-DSS 4.0 card tokenization using tok_pci_v2_<32hex>, 45ms synchronous fraud scoring via api-fraud-score-v1, and fail-closed rejection on > $500 charges; supersedes ADR-001.

properties.title: Idempotency Keys & Exactly-Once Financial Commit Semantics
properties.summary: Mandates client-supplied UUIDv4 Idempotency-Key headers with 72-hour deduplication windows and atomic commit semantics across payments, checkout, billing, orders, and ledger APIs.

properties.title: Zero-Trust Service-to-Service mTLS & Short-Lived OIDC Tokens
properties.summary: Mandates zero-trust mutual TLS (mTLS) and 5-minute scoped OIDC bearer tokens minted by svc-auth (api-auth-token-v2) for all east-west service calls.

properties.title: Asynchronous Event Envelope & Dead-Letter Queue Contract
properties.summary: Standardizes CloudEvents-compatible asynchronous event envelopes, correlation trace IDs, exponential backoff, and dead-letter queue replay across notifications, webhooks, and analytics.

properties.title: Double-Entry Ledger Write-Ahead Posting & Reconciliation
properties.summary: Replaces nightly batch settlement with synchronous write-ahead double-entry posting on svc-ledger (api-ledger-post-v2) guaranteeing zero drift and SOX auditability; supersedes ADR-002.

properties.title: Inventory Soft-Lock Reservation & 15-Minute Expiry TTL
properties.summary: Establishes 15-minute TTL soft-lock inventory reservations on svc-inventory (api-inventory-reserve-v1) with automated expiry cleanup and saga release on failed payments.

properties.title: Tier-0 API 180-Day Breaking-Change Freeze Policy
properties.summary: Enforces a mandatory 180-day Tier-0 API breaking-change freeze with dual-version parallel rollout and Architecture Review Board sign-off before deprecating contracts; supersedes ADR-003.

properties.title: Cardholder Data Tokenization (tok_pci_v2_<32hex>)
properties.description: PCI-DSS 4.0 Requirement 3.5: All payment endpoints MUST accept vaulted card tokens matching tok_pci_v2_<32hex> and prohibit raw PAN storage or transmission outside the isolated card vault.

properties.title: Tier-0 Payment Latency (p99 <= 180ms, Fraud <= 45ms, 99.99% SLA)
properties.description: Tier-0 Payment SLA: POST /v2/payments/charge MUST achieve p99 <= 180ms end-to-end latency, synchronous fraud evaluation MUST stay <= 45ms, and service availability MUST meet 99.99%.

properties.title: High-Value (> $500) Fail-Closed Fraud Scoring Gate
properties.description: Enterprise Risk Policy: Transactions with amount > $500 MUST pass synchronous real-time fraud scoring and fail-closed (HTTP 503/422 decline) whenever svc-fraud times out past 45ms or is unreachable.

properties.title: Legacy v1 Payment Charge Endpoint Sunset
properties.description: Legacy Sunset Mandate: Retire DEPRECATED POST /v1/payments/charge (api-payments-charge-v1) by migrating the final AT_RISK consumer svc-billing onto api-payments-charge-v2.

properties.title: SOX Financial Auditability & 1:1 Idempotent Ledger Posting
properties.description: SOX Section 404 Financial Controls: Every monetary charge and refund MUST carry an immutable Idempotency-Key and produce a 1:1 balanced double-entry journal in svc-ledger with zero orphaned postings.

properties.title: Zero-Trust mTLS & Scoped OIDC Authorization
properties.description: Zero-Trust Security Baseline: All service-to-service traffic MUST authenticate via mTLS workload certificates and short-lived scoped OIDC tokens issued by svc-auth (api-auth-token-v2).

properties.title: Thailand PDPA Primary Operational Data Residency (asia-southeast3)
properties.description: Thailand PDPA Operational Residency: Primary operational customer, order, payment, and ledger data MUST reside in Bangkok (asia-southeast3) with documented cross-border controls for secondary AI/DR processing.

properties.title: 180-Day Breaking Change Freeze for Tier-0 APIs
properties.description: Tier-0 Change Management Policy: Breaking schema or behavioral changes to any Tier-0 API require a 180-day deprecation freeze, dual-version support, and documented consumer migration sign-off per ADR-010.

properties.title: Checkout Cart-to-Order Saga Compensation Consistency
properties.description: Checkout Resilience Standard: Cart-to-order workflows MUST execute deterministic saga compensations releasing svc-inventory soft-locks and voiding partial authorizations if payment capture fails.

properties.title: At-Least-Once Webhook Delivery & HMAC-SHA256 Signing
properties.description: Partner Messaging Contract: Outbound merchant webhooks MUST guarantee at-least-once delivery with exponential retry, dead-letter queuing, and HMAC-SHA256 request signing.

properties.title: Distributed Trace Propagation & Structured DB Request Tags
properties.description: End-to-End Observability Standard: Every synchronous RPC and asynchronous event MUST propagate W3C traceparent headers and emit structured database request tags for latency and lock attribution.

properties.title: Analytics PII Pseudonymization & Async DATA_FEED Isolation
properties.description: Analytics Privacy & Isolation: Downstream analytics pipelines (svc-analytics) MUST consume pseudonymized async DATA_FEED streams strictly isolated from synchronous OLTP checkout and payment failure domains.

properties.title: Partner Gateway Per-Tenant Rate Limiting & Quota Isolation
properties.description: B2B Perimeter Protection: Partner ingress on svc-partner-gw MUST enforce per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting, payload size caps, and quota isolation to prevent noisy-neighbor cascades.

properties.title: Cross-Region Spanner Backup DR Copy to Singapore (asia-southeast1)
properties.description: Disaster Recovery Standard: Production Tier-0 databases in regional-asia-southeast3 MUST replicate automated encrypted Cloud Spanner backups cross-region to Singapore (asia-southeast1) meeting RPO <= 15m and RTO <= 60m.
